integrity: Proof and checker concern an independently defined mathematical model. The motivating study supplies motivation and public date evidence, not the asserted mathematical theorem or calibrated rates. The result is not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Poisson detection and constant method-specific positive capture rates are idealized and not fitted to the motivating field data.
Expected richness alone is compared, not realized richness, statistical significance, or equal-total-yield standardization.
The statement establishes minimal taxon count for two reversals, not maximum reversal count for all taxon counts.
title: Three taxa are the minimum for reentrant species-richness rankings between Poisson-capture methods
